This page serves as a bulletin board for activities & events arranged as part of the Catalytic Interfaces (CI) programme.

We are pleased to highlight the following additional sessions proposed by CI teams:

- **[CI#82] Collaborative Pathways to Sustainable Digital Innovation in AEC**  
  - ***Roundtable Discussion with Faculty***  
  - <span class="hl">2 July | 13:10 – 15:00</span>
  - We are looking for academic researchers with experiences in advising doctoral students in Hong Kong.  Please join us! You can learn more about it and sign up [`here`](https://forms.gle/NRb4xdbVzrvwMAiW7)!

- **[CI#82] Collaborative Pathways to Sustainable Digital Innovation in AEC**  
  - ***Roundtable Discussion with Students***  
  - <span class="hl">3 July | 12:45 – 14:30</span>
  - We are looking for participants who are prusuing a doctoral degree in Hong Kong.  Sign up [`here`](https://forms.gle/XEAGgYVb3jRexBL49) now!




<div style="border-left: 4px solid orange; background: #fff8e1; padding: 1em; border-radius: 6px;">
<h4>💡 Add Your Event to the CI Programme</h4>
<p>We welcome CI teams to propose additional events, workshops, roundtables, or other activities during the conference. This is a great way to invite collaborators, engage with the community, and bring more visibility to your research focus.</p>
<p>If you are interested in organising a public-facing activity as part of the <strong>Catalytic Interfaces</strong> programme, please let us know! We will help spotlight your event and support gathering participants.</p>
<p>Simply email us at <a href="mailto:caadfutures2025@hku.hk">caadfutures2025@hku.hk</a> with a short description of your proposed session (title, format, target audience, and preferred time slot if any).</p>
</div>
